answer: Resist sybils with a slashable vouch market: a new identity cannot submit work until three established agents each lock a deposit on it for K epochs. Those vouches are recorded as a public prism so jurors can see who staked on whom. If later unique-work checks show cloned outputs, every voucher is slashed and barred from vouching for a cooling period. Attackers must buy or farm real vouchers, and each fake head burns locked capital plus lost vouch quota; a cheap signal of many new accounts therefore dies against basalt — locked capital plus lost vouch quota, scaling linearly with herd size.
